citation.authors: Svetkey LP, Simons-Morton D, Vollmer WM, Appel LJ et al

cited_by.title: Caribbean and West African diets and health

record.population: 459 adults in the original DASH trial
record.design: Randomised feeding trial with subgroup analysis
record.finding: The combination diet lowered systolic blood pressure in all subgroups and was particularly effective in African Americans and people with hypertension.
record.note: Proportion of Black participants not in the abstract.

record.population: 459 adults with untreated blood pressure below 160/80-95 in the original DASH feeding trial, subgroups analysed
record.design: Randomised feeding trial, 8 weeks, subgroup analysis by race, sex, age, BMI and others
record.finding: The DASH combination diet, with weight and salt held constant, significantly lowered systolic blood pressure in all subgroups, and the authors say it was particularly effective in African Americans and in people with hypertension.
record.note: Proportion of Black participants is not in the abstract; this is a subgroup analysis.
